current.messageZh: 強烈季候風信號現正生效。 火災危險警告為紅色，表示火災危險性極高。
current.messageEn: The Strong Monsoon Signal has been issued. The Fire Danger Warning is Red and the fire risk is extreme.

forecast.generalSituationZh: 東北季候風會在今明兩日為廣東帶來普遍晴朗及非常乾燥的天氣，該區早上清涼，日夜溫差頗大。隨著季候風在本週後期緩和，該區氣溫回升。預料受高空擾動影響，週末期間華南雲量增多及有幾陣驟雨，下週初沿岸地區天氣較為潮濕。而另一股東北季候風會在下週中期影響廣東沿岸。此外，熱帶氣旋查帕卡會在今明兩日橫過日本以南海域，隨後逐漸演變為溫帶氣旋。
forecast.generalSituationEn: The northeast monsoon will bring generally fine and very dry weather to Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be cool in the morning over the region with rather large temperature difference between day and night. With the monsoon moderating in the latter part of this week, temperatures will rise over the region. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, it will be cloudier with a few showers over southern China over the weekend. The weather will be relatively humid over the coastal areas early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Cempaka will move across the seas south of Japan today and tomorrow, then evolve into an extratropical cyclone gradually.

days.weatherZh: 早上清涼。天晴。日間非常乾燥。
days.weatherEn: Cool in the morning. Fine. Very dry during the day.
days.windZh: 北風5級，初時離岸及高地6級。稍後東北風4級。
days.windEn: North force 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground at first. Northeast force 4 later.

days.weatherEn: Fine and dry. Slightly cooler in the morning.
Mainly fine. Dry during the day.
days.windEn: East to northeast force 4, force 5 offshore.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，日間短暫時間有陽光。晚上有一兩陣驟雨。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. Sunny intervals during the day. One or two showers at night.
Mainly cloudy with a few showers.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，初時有一兩陣驟雨。日間短暫時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. One or two showers at first. Sunny intervals during the day.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，早晚有一兩陣微雨，部分地區能見度較低。日間短暫時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches and relatively low visibility in some areas in the morning and at night. Sunny intervals during the day.

days.windZh: 初時微風2級，後轉東北風4至5級。
days.windEn: Light winds force 2 at first, becoming northeast force 4 to 5 later.
